description: Data visualisation — KPI cards, charts, tables, and exportable reports.

screens_added.name: Analytics Overview
screens_added.purpose: KPI cards + summary charts at a glance

screens_added.name: Report Detail
screens_added.purpose: Deep dive into a specific metric or time range

screens_added.name: Data Table
screens_added.purpose: Tabular data with sort, filter, and export

flows_added: View dashboard → spot metric → tap → drill into report detail
Select date range → data updates → export as CSV or PDF
Set metric alert → threshold fires → notification sent → view in dashboard
interaction_patterns: KPI cards animate in on load — counter counts up to current value
Chart tap — shows exact value tooltip at tapped point
Date range picker — presets (7d, 30d, 90d, custom) as chip row
Table sort — tap column header, tap again to reverse
Export button always accessible — CSV and PDF
Empty state on no data — clear explanation, not just a blank chart

error_flows.trigger: Data fails to load for a metric
error_flows.ui: Individual chart shows error state inline — not full page error. Icon: warning triangle. Message: 'Could not load [metric name]'. Retry button per chart. Other charts unaffected. Partial dashboard always better than full failure.
Chart area shows: 'No data for this period'. Previous period CTA: 'Try last 30 days'. Do not show empty axes — replace with message. Suggest date ranges that do have data if known.

Toast: 'Export failed — please try again'. If large export: 'File is too large to export at once — try a shorter date range'. Progress indicator on large exports. Never leave user waiting with no feedback.
Last updated timestamp shown on live metrics. Amber badge: 'Live data paused'. Auto-reconnect in background. On reconnect: refresh all metrics simultaneously, not one by one.

error_flows.trigger: Metric alert threshold fires but notification fails to deliver
error_flows.ui: Alert still recorded in notification centre. Shown as unread on next app open with timestamp of when threshold was breached. Never silently miss an alert.

edge_cases.case: All metrics are zero (new account, no activity)
edge_cases.ui: Show metrics at zero with onboarding guidance instead of empty charts. 'Your data will appear here once you have [X] activity'. Do not show flat zero lines on charts — show empty state illustration instead.

edge_cases.case: Single data point in a time series chart
edge_cases.ui: Show as a single dot, not a line. Horizontal reference line at value. Label with date and value. Never draw a line chart with one point — it implies trend where there is none.

edge_cases.case: Metric value exceeds chart scale dramatically (spike)
edge_cases.ui: Auto-scale Y axis to include spike. Label the spike point with value and date. Option to 'Exclude outlier' to see underlying trend. Never clip data off the chart.

edge_cases.case: User changes date range while data is still loading
edge_cases.ui: Cancel previous request immediately. Start new request for new date range. Never show mixed data from two different date ranges.

edge_cases.case: Comparison period has different number of days (e.g. Feb vs March)
edge_cases.ui: Normalise to daily averages for comparison, not raw totals. Label clearly: 'Per day average'. Never compare 28-day February total directly to 31-day March total without disclosure.

edge_cases.case: Negative metric value (returns exceed sales, refunds exceed revenue)
edge_cases.ui: Show negative values in red. Allow Y axis to go below zero. Never hide negative values or floor at zero. Negative data is valid and important.
